verses.text: <pb/><t>Tonu Ja.</t> <t>M'gēwere obim nile kele Jehova,</t> <t>N'ìzu nzuzo nke ndi ziri ezi, na nime nzukọ Israel.</t>
<t>Ọlu nile nke Jehova di uku,</t> <t>Buru ihe ndi nile ha nātọ utọ nāchọputa.</t>
<t>Ebube na ima-nma ka ọlu-Ya bu:</t> <t>Ezi omume-Ya nēguzo kwa rue mb͕e ebighi-ebi.</t>
<t>Ihe-ncheta ka O meworo nye oké ọlu-Ya nile:</t> <t>Onye nēme ebere na Onye nwere obi-ebere ka Jehova bu.</t>
<t>Anu-ndọb͕u ka O nyeworo ndi nātu egwu Ya:</t> <t>Ọ gēcheta ọb͕ub͕a-ndu-Ya rue mb͕e ebighi-ebi.</t>
<t>O gosiwo ndi-Ya ike nke ọlu-Ya nile,</t> <t>N'inye ha ihe-nketa mba nile.</t>
<t>Ọlu nile nke aka-Ya bu ezi-okwu na ikpé ziri ezi;</t> <t>Ihe kwesiri ntukwasi-obi ka ukpuru-Ya nile bu.</t>
<t>Ihe anākwagide rue mb͕e nile ebighi-ebi ka ha bu,</t> <t>Ha bu ihe anēme n'ezi-okwu na izi-ezi.</t>
<t>Nb͕aputa ka O ziteworo ndi-Ya;</t> <t>O nyewo ọb͕ub͕a-ndu-Ya iwu rue mb͕e ebighi-ebi:</t> <t>Ihe di nsọ na ihe anātu egwu ka aha-Ya bu.</t>
<t>Nmalite amam-ihe ka egwu Jehova bu;</t> <t>Ezi uche ka ndi nile nēme ha nwere:</t> <t>Otuto-Ya nēguzo rue mb͕e ebighi-ebi.</t>
